name: Wagamama Sensei wa Boku no Imouto? ~Ubu na Aitsu ga H na Shousetsu Nante~
original_name: ワガママ先生は僕の妹？ ～ウブなアイツがＨな小説なんて…～
source:
By chance, I noticed that my younger sister Kana's laptop was still open, so I casually peeked at the screen to close it.
What was displayed on the screen was an erotic novel.
And the theme was "Brother and Sister."
Confused, I scrolled through the text...and then I noticed something strange.
This wasn't something she was just reading, it was something Kana had written.
Having discovered my sister's secret, I tried to apologize to Kana, but...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1320832]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
一次偶然的机会，我发现妹妹加奈的笔记本电脑还开着，于是我随意地看了一眼屏幕，将其关闭。
屏幕上显示的是一本情色小说。
主题是“兄弟姐妹”。
我很困惑，滚动浏览了文字……然后我发现了一些奇怪的东西。
这不是她刚刚读到的东西，而是卡纳写的东西。
发现姐姐的秘密后，我试图向加奈道歉，但是……
